_description: Gold dataset for the E8-handoff-faithfulness evaluation, registered in app/evals/plan.py. Owner: Heriz Yusoff. DECOUPLED BY DESIGN: each row specifies the upstream CaseState fields DIRECTLY (as if intake/classifier/safety/routing/hitl/reflection had already run) rather than raw patient text driven through the real pipeline -- so this fixture and its test have zero dependency on any other agent's code. `decoy_terms` are plausible-sounding clinical facts that appear NOWHERE in the row's fields -- a faithful summary must never contain them. `required_terms` are facts that must survive into the summary so a 'faithful' summary cannot pass simply by saying nothing.

_schema.id: stable identifier, used in failure messages
_schema.normalised_symptoms: as Symptom-Intake would have produced it
_schema.raw_text: the original patient words, for realism only -- not parsed by this test
_schema.acuity_code: as the Severity-Classifier + Safety-Override would have left it
_schema.confidence: as the Severity-Classifier would have left it
_schema.evidence: as the Severity-Classifier would have left it
_schema.safety_triggered: as the Safety-Override worker would have left it
_schema.safety_rule: as the Safety-Override worker would have left it, or null
_schema.safety_reason: as the Safety-Override worker would have left it, or null
_schema.escalation_reason: as HITL/Reflection would have left it
_schema.decoy_terms: fabricated clinical facts ABSENT from every field above; must not appear in the generated summary (case-insensitive substring check)
_schema.required_terms: facts that must survive into the generated summary (case-insensitive substring check)
